建香港的承諾，以創造更美好和可持續的未來。                                                        銀行將努力體現與客戶『同步更進
                                                                             步 』的 品 牌 理 念，努 力 承 傳 審 慎 財
Dah Sing Bank commemorated its 75th anniversary in 2022. To celebrate this   務 信 念，不 斷 培 育 著 重 服 務 質 素
important milestone, the Bank launched a series of activities designed to    的文化，為客戶提供適切和歷久常
show its gratitude towards its customers, and to reflect its commitment to   新的體驗。」

                                                                                                                  。計劃透過舉辦兩個分別針對建築及房地產業和零售及
                                                                                                    電子商貿業的專題論壇，向中小企介紹環境、社會及管治（ESG）大趨勢對相關行業下
                                                                                                    游和供應鏈帶來的影響以至所衍生的發展機遇，從而實踐可持續營運。
                                                                Support for SME
                                                                Sustainability                      To support SMEs in their transition to sustainable business practices, the Bank
                                                                                                    collaborated with Friends of the Earth (HK) to jointly present the “SME ESG Best
                                                                Journey                             Practices Recognition Programme”. The programme included two industry-
                                                                                                    specific educational forums to help SMEs understand how evolving ESG trends are
                                                                                                    impacting and shaping sustainable downstream and supply chain opportunities
                                                                                                    relevant to the property and construction as well as the retail and e-commerce
                                                                                                    sectors respectively.

     漸減退，惟美國及歐洲經濟增長可能放緩。在此     although earlier concerns about more severe recessionary conditions
     環境下，環球市場的波動性高於預測水平，而近     now appear to be reducing. Against this, global markets have been

     的考驗。雖然這形勢並不會對我們或亞洲同業帶     has recently been tested by the failures of a number of banks in the US

本集團之薪酬政策旨在為僱員維持與市場條件相   The Group’s policy on remuneration is to maintain fair and competitive
若、公平且具競爭力之薪酬配套，並根據業務需   packages for its employees, which are commensurate with market
要、專業才能、個人之素質，且參照行業慣例與   terms, and are based on business needs, expertise and quality of
監管指引而訂立。                the individuals, and with proper reference to industry practice and
                        regulatory guidelines.


就釐定支付予董事會成員之袍金水平而言，將會   For determining the level of fees paid to members of the Board of
考慮市場的袍金水平及各董事之工作量及其須作   Directors, market rates and factors such as each director’s workload
出之承擔等因素。釐定執行董事薪酬待遇之考慮   and required commitment will be taken into account. The following
因素如下：                   factors are considered when determining the remuneration packages of
                        EDs:


－   業務需要及表現             –      Business needs and performance


－   整體經濟及商業情況           –      The economy and business conditions in general


－   個別對本集團之貢獻           –      Each individual’s contributions to the Group


－   風險相關之表現             –      Risk related performance


－   參考與個人職責相符之市場薪酬水平    –      Reference to market pay level commensurate with the individual’s
                               responsibility

     面的考慮因素。甄選人選將按一系列多元化範疇         development. Board diversity has been considered from a number of

     員多元化的裨益。                      considered against objective criteria, having due regard for the factors
                                   on personal attributes outlined above, expectation on contribution to the

      2.3 利息收入及支出                                               2.3 Interest income and expense

      所有按攤餘成本及以公平值計量且其變動計入其                                     Interest income and expense are recognised in the consolidated
      他全面收益計量之債務工具的利息收入及支出乃                                     income statement for all debt instruments measured at amortised cost
      應用實際利率法確認於綜合收益賬內。                                         and fair value through other comprehensive income using the effective
                                                                interest method.


      實際利率法乃是一種用以計算金融資產或金融負                                     The effective interest method is a method of calculating the amortised
      債之攤餘成本及其於相關期內攤分利息收入或利                                     cost of a financial asset or a financial liability and of allocating the
      息支出的方法。實際利率指可將金融工具在預計                                     interest income or interest expense over the relevant period. The
      有效期間或較短期間（如適用）內之估計未來現金                                    effective interest rate is the rate that exactly discounts estimated future
      收支貼現為該金融資產或金融負債之賬面淨值之                                     cash payments or receipts through the expected life of the financial
      適用貼現率。在計算實際利率時，本集團按金融                                     instrument or, when appropriate, a shorter period to the net carrying
      工具之所有合約條款（如提早清還之行使權）而估                                    amount of the financial asset or financial liability. When calculating the
      計其現金流量，但不考慮未發生之信貸損失。此                                     effective interest rate, the Group estimates cash flows considering all
      計算包括所有合約內交易雙方所收取或支付能構                                     contractual terms of the financial instrument (for example, prepayment
      成整體實際利息之費用及利率差價、交易成本及                                     options) but does not consider future credit losses. The calculation
      所有其他溢價或折讓。                                                includes all fees and points paid or received between parties to
                                                                the contract that are an integral part of the effective interest rate,
                                                                transaction costs and all other premiums or discounts.


      若一項金融資產或一組金融資產的價值因減值虧                                     Once a financial asset or a group of similar financial assets has been
      損被調低，其利息收入則按計算有關減值虧損時                                     written down as a result of an impairment loss, interest income is
      所應用以貼現未來現金流量之利率來計量確認。                                     recognised using the rate of interest used to discount the future cash

期基礎評估及不時根據實際經驗及估價重新評估     and purpose are determined and documented at the inception of each
對沖有效性。倘公平值對沖關係不符合對沖會計     fair value hedge. Hedge effectiveness is assessed at inception on a
的有效性測試標準，則對沖會計方法將於此公平     prospective basis and is reassessed, on an ongoing basis, based on
值對沖失效日起停止。                actual experience and valuation. Fair value hedge relationships that do
                          not meet the effectiveness test requirement of hedge accounting are
                          discontinued with effect from the date of ineffectiveness of the fair value
                          hedge.

      利率風險之公平值對沖                                                Fair value hedges of interest rate risk

      本集團採用利率掉期以對沖指標利率對發行之定                                     The Group uses interest rate swaps to hedge its exposure to changes
      息負債及持有之定息債務證券所產生之公平值變                                     in the fair values of fixed-rate issued liabilities and fixed-rate debt
      動風險。其支付浮息╱收取定息之利率掉期與特                                     securities held in respect of a benchmark interest rate. Pay-floating/
      定的定息負債配對，或支付定息╱收取浮息之利                                     receive-fixed interest rate swaps are matched to specific issuances of
      率掉期與持有之定息債務證券配對（其條款與對沖                                    fixed-rate liabilities or pay-fixed/receive-floating interest rate swaps are
      項目之關鍵條款緊密一致）。                                             matched to fixed-rate debt securities held with terms that closely align
                                                                with the critical terms of the hedged item.


      本集團僅對沖利率風險部分及管理但非對沖其他                                     Only the interest rate risk element is hedged and therefore other risks,
      風險（例如信貸風險）。本集團應用對沖會計處理                                    such as credit risk, are managed but not hedged by the Group. Interest
      之利率風險源自發行之定息負債及持有之定息債                                     rate risk to which the Group applies hedge accounting arises from
      務證券，其公平值因指標利率變動而波動。由於                                     fixed-rate issued liabilities and fixed-rate debt securities held, whose
      指標利率之變動重大地影響發行之負債或債務證                                     fair value fluctuates when benchmark interest rates change. The Group
      券之公平值變動，本集團僅就指標利率對沖利率                                     hedges interest rate risk only to the extent of benchmark interest rates
      風險。當經濟對沖關係符合對沖會計處理之準則                                     because the changes in fair value of an issued liability or a debt security
      時則應用對沖會計處理。                                               are significantly influenced by changes in the benchmark interest rate.
                                                                Hedge accounting is applied where economic hedge relationships meet
                                                                the hedge accounting criteria.


      本集團應用公平值對沖會計處理前，按對沖項目                                     Before fair value hedge accounting is applied by the Group, the Group
      之質化特性及量化分析支持對沖風險之評估釐定                                     determines whether an economic relationship between the hedged
      對沖項目與對沖工具間是否存在經濟關係。本集                                     item and the hedging instrument exists based on an evaluation of the
      團在評估經濟關係是否存在時會考慮對沖項目及                                     qualitative characteristics of these items and the hedged risk that is
      對沖工具之關鍵條款是否緊密一致。本集團評估                                     supported by quantitative analysis. The Group considers whether the
      對沖項目及對沖工具之公平值是否就同類型風險                                     critical terms of the hedged item and hedging instrument closely align
      有同樣反應。                                                    when assessing the presence of an economic relationship. The Group
                                                                evaluates whether the fair value of the hedged item and the hedging
                                                                instrument respond similarly to similar risks.

預期信貸虧損模型的優化                   ECL model refinements

於2022年，2019新冠肺炎疫情所帶來的經營環境     In 2022, the COVID-19 pandemic had led to rapid deterioration in
急促轉壞及史無前例的全球性經濟不穩定，由於         business conditions and unprecedented economic uncertainty, which
疫情為相當特殊的事件，超出預期信貸虧損模型         had affected the performance of ECL models since it is a rather
依據過往觀察之模式設定，因此預期信貸虧損模         exceptional event that was beyond historical observations of the model
型的準確性受到影響。加上市場對中國國內房地         setting. Coupled with market’s concern on the PRC property developer
產市場的憂慮及市場利率急速上升，以及在應對         sector as well as the rapid rise in interest rates, there were challenges
宏觀經濟和市場環境的突變時，預期信貸虧損模         to model performances as the ECL estimates could be overly sensitive
型的推算可能過於敏感，從而預期信貸虧損模型         in response to such interplay of abrupt changes in macroeconomic
的準確性面臨挑戰。為恰當地反映於此等宏觀經         factors and market environment. To properly reflect asset quality of the
濟情況下的信貸組合資產質素，本集團繼續於預         credit portfolios under such conditions, the Group continued to conduct
期信貸虧損模型結果之基礎上進行各種組合審視         various portfolio reviews and performed statistical analysis to assess
並進行統計分析，以評估模型結果的合理性，並         reasonableness of ECL model outputs and come up with refinements, if
且在必要時改進。                      considered necessary.


基於以上背景，本集團已採用由具信譽的宏觀經         Against such background, refinements were made on a few

損模型使用的宏觀經濟因素，這將帶來未被當前         factors given by reputable macroeconomic forecast agencies would

本集團依據大範圍之前瞻性經濟資料作為模型參         The Group relies on a broad range of forward-looking economic
數，例如宏觀經濟因素好像物業價格指數、生產         indicators as model inputs, such as the forecasts of macroeconomic
總值增長率、失業率及利率等之預測。所選擇的         factors (“MEFs”) such as property price indices, GDP growth rates,
宏觀經濟因素均通過了業界普遍採用的嚴格統計         unemployment rates, and interest rates. The selection of MEFs had
數據測試及專業判斷，以確保預期信貸虧損模型         gone through stringent statistical data tests commonly adopted by the
中所使用的宏觀經濟因素與集團信貸組合的風險         industry as well as expert judgements to ensure that MEFs used in
狀況相關及具反映性，並同時滿足所需的定量標         the ECL models are relevant to and reflective of the risk profile of the
準。                            Group’s credit portfolios while satisfying required quantitative standards.

3.3.1 源自買賣賬之市場風險（續）               3.3.1 Market risk arising from the trading book (Continued)

     （甲） 市場風險計量方法（續）                   (a)    Market risk measurement technique (Continued)

        (i)   市場風險數值                          (i)      Value at risk

        本集團應用市場風險數值法，其乃一                      The Group applies a VaR methodology, which is a
        種以統計為基準就持作買賣用途組合                      statistically based estimate, to measure the potential loss
        因市場不利變化預計潛在損失。其表                      of its trading portfolio from adverse market movements. It
        明本集團於某個置信水平可能損失之                      expresses as the maximum amount the Group might lose
        最大數額，就一日持倉期之基準作推                      given a certain level of confidence, which for the Group
        算，本集團之置信水平為99%。因此                     is 99% for a one day holding period. There is therefore a
        存在明確的統計概率，實際損失可能                      specified statistical probability that actual loss could be
        比市場風險數值之估計數為大。因此                      greater than the VaR estimate. Hence, the use of VaR does
        採納該方法並不能避免當市場狀況發                      not prevent losses outside the VaR limits in the event of
        生重大變化時超逾此等額度之損失。                      extreme market movements.


        市場風險數值模型假設某個持倉期                       The VaR model assumes a certain “holding period” (one

      3.4.1 流動資金風險管理程序                                          3.4.1 Liquidity risk management process

      本集團按審慎原則管理資金流動性，旨在符合法                                     The Group manages its liquidity on a prudent basis with the objective
      定準則及確保有充足之流動性及融資能力，以                                      to comply with the statutory standards and to ensure that there is
      應付日常的業務營運及能承受嚴重資金壓力。本                                     an adequate liquidity and funding capacity to meet normal business
      集團已採納香港金管局指定之流動資產維持比率                                     operations and to withstand severe liquidity stresses. The Group has
      （「流動資產維持比率」）及核心資金比率（「核心                                   adopted the Liquidity Maintenance Ratio (“LMR”) and the Core Funding
      資金比率」）為呈報本集團流動資金狀況之監管準                                    Ratio (“CFR”) as the regulatory standards specified by the HKMA for
      則。本集團於期內保持流動資產維持比率及核心                                     reporting on the Group’s liquidity position. During the period, the Group
      資金比率遠高於法定最低要求的分別為25%及                                     had maintained sufficiently high LMR and CFR well above the statutory
      75%。                                                      minimum of 25% and 75% respectively.


      此外，本集團已根據香港金管局《監管政策手冊》                                    Moreover, the Group has maintained a sound liquidity risk management
      LM-1「流動性風險監管制度」及《監管政策手冊》單                                 framework in accordance with the HKMA’s requirements set forth in the
      元LM-2「穩健的流動性風險管理制度及管控措施」                                  SPM LM-1 on “Regulatory Framework for Supervision of Liquidity Risk”
      之規定維護健全的流動性風險管理框架。《監管政                                    and the SPM LM-2 on “Sound Systems and Controls for Liquidity Risk
      策手冊》LM-1旨在提供香港金管局採納用以監管                                   Management”. The SPM LM-1 is to provide the approach adopted by
      及評估銀行流動性風險之方法，而《監管政策手                                     the HKMA for supervising and assessing the liquidity risk of banks while
      冊》LM-2乃為實施巴塞爾銀行監管委員會（「巴塞                                  the SPM LM-2 is developed to implement the liquidity sound principles
      爾委員會」）所確立之健全流動性原則而制定，旨                                    formulated by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (“Basel
      在強化銀行的流動性風險管理標準。                                          Committee”) to strengthen the liquidity risk management standards of
                                                                banks.


      流動性風險管理乃遵照經董事會批准之政策及框                                     Liquidity risk management is governed by the policy and framework
      架管理，據此授權本集團的資產及負債管理委員                                     approved by the Board, which delegates to the Group’s ALCO to
      會監控流動性風險管理。本集團的資產及負債管                                     oversee liquidity risk management. The ALCO regularly reviews the
      理委員會定期檢討本集團之貸款及存款的組合及                                     Group’s loan and deposit mix and changes, funding requirements and
      變化、融資需求及預測，以及對一系列包括流動                                     projections, and monitors a set of liquidity risk metrics, including the
      資產維持比率、核心資金比率及到期錯配狀況之                                     LMR, CFR and maturity mismatch on an ongoing basis. In addition,
      流動性風險度量作持續監控。此外，資產及負債                                     material changes in the liquidity risk metrics together with any
      管理委員會審閱流動性風險指標的重大變化以及                                     corresponding proposed mitigation actions will be reviewed by ALCO.
      任何相應的建議緩解措施。本集團對此等風險度                                     Appropriate limits or triggers on these risk metrics are set and sufficient
      量訂定適當的限額及觸發額，並持有充足的流動                                     liquid assets are held to ensure that the Group can maintain a sufficient

就編製分項報告而言，對可直接認明為各個別分     For the purpose of segment reporting, revenue derived from customers,
項之源自客戶、產品及服務收入，將直接呈報於     products and services directly identifiable with individual segments
有關分項；而分項之間的資金運用及資金資源所     are reported directly under respective segments, while revenue
產生的收入和資金成本，按參照市場利率之轉移     and funding cost arising from inter-segment funding operation and
價格機制分配至各分項。分項間之交易乃依據授     funding resources are allocated to segments by way of transfer pricing
予第三者或與第三者交易之同類條款定價。分項     mechanism with reference to market interest rates. Transactions within
間之收入或支出於綜合賬內抵銷。           segments are priced based on similar terms offered to or transacted
                          with external parties. Inter-segment income or expenses are eliminated
                          on consolidation.


所有不同分項之直接開支將歸類於有關的分項分     All direct costs incurred by different segments are grouped under
類。間接開支及支援部門開支乃依據開支性質，     respective segments. Indirect costs and support functions’ costs are
按耗用之時間及工作量和分項營運收入，分配至     allocated to various segments and products based on effort and time
不同的分項及產品。不能合理地分配至各分項、     spent as well as segments’ operating income depending on the nature
產品及支援部門之企業活動開支，則作企業開支     of costs incurred. Costs related to corporate activities that cannot be
呈列於「其他」項下。                reasonably allocated to segments, products and support functions are
                          grouped under Others as unallocated corporate expenses.

         值                                                            recognised in 2022

      於2022年12月31日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資之                                 At 31 December 2022, the fair value of the Group’s investment in
      公平值已低於賬面值大約9年。為此，本集團持續                                    BOCQ had been below the carrying amount for approximately 9 years.
      對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測試以評                                     On this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment test on the
      估可收回金額。                                                   carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the recoverable
                                                                amount.


      減值測試比對以計算使用價值（「使用價值」）而釐                                   The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable amount
      定之重慶銀行可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使                                     of BOCQ, determined by a value in use (“VIU”) calculation, with the
      用價值乃按照管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來                                     carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses discounted
      將派股息，及經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長                                     cash flow projections based on management’s estimates of BOCQ’s
      及資產淨值後之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用                                     earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the estimated probable
      貼現現金流量預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之                                     exit value in future after considering the growth of BOCQ and its net
      貼現率乃參考可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本                                     asset value for the medium and longer term. The discount rate applied
      成本而估算。                                                    to the VIU calculation was estimated with reference to BOCQ’s cost of
                                                                equity, which is publicly available in the market.


      進行使用價值計算以得出該投資之可收回金額                                      In performing the VIU calculation to arrive at the recoverable amount
      時，本集團考慮所有相關因素包括市場觀點及質                                     of the investment, the Group considers all relevant factors including
      化因素以確保計算使用價值之參數合適。調整亦                                     market views and qualitative factors to ensure that the inputs to the
      須作出以反映影響重慶銀行之最新情況及對預測                                     VIU calculation are appropriate. Adjustments need to be made to
      重慶銀行未來表現有關之中期及長期市場展望。                                     reflect the latest situation affecting BOCQ and also market outlook for
      在估算重慶銀行之未來現金流當中需要管理層作                                     the medium and longer term that are relevant in projecting BOCQ’s
      重要判斷。                                                     future performance. Significant management judgement is required in
                                                                estimating the future cash flows of BOCQ.

值而釐定之現金產生單位可回收金額。該計算應           comparing the recoverable amount of CGU determined based on
用由高層管理人員所編制，以5年計劃之預測現           value in use calculation. The calculations use discounted cash flow
金流，經考慮預測每年增長率且以固定年增長率           projections prepared by the Senior Management based on the latest
2%推測第5年以後至永遠。該5年計劃由高層管理         5-year business plan, taking into account projected annual growth
人員基於其對有關現金產生單位之業務及該業務           rate of net profit, and in perpetuity with 2% constant growth rate
於預測時期內的運作情況之評估所編制。所應用           after the fifth year. The 5-year business plan was developed by the
之貼現率乃建基於本集團之資本成本加權平均數           Senior Management based on their evaluation of the businesses and
11.10%（2021年：11.12%）。           associated projected discounted cash flow of net profit of the relevant
                                CGU and the conditions in which such businesses will operate over
                                the projection period. The discount rate used is based on the Group’s
                                weighted average cost of capital at 11.10% (2021: 11.12%).

      使重大影響力。倘若其他不同人士受到共同控制                                     the other party in making financial and operating decisions. Parties are
      或共同重大影響時，彼等人士亦被視為有關連人                                     also considered to be related if they are subject to common control or
      士。                                                        common significant influence.

總體淨額結算安排                    Master netting arrangements

本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結算安       To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦       arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易       agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。       transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額       outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
結算及一般不會在綜合財務狀況表中對銷資產及       default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
負債。                         on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets and
                            liabilities in the consolidated statement of financial position.
